title: Monday Haircare’s Jaimee Lupton’s billion-dollar mission to democratise beauty – and launch 20 new brands
summary: Jaimee Lupton, founder of Monday Haircare and body and fragrance brand Daise, on building and scaling winning brands, reaching AUD $1bn sales this year and why she is going to launch 20 more brands

extraction.key_fact: 먼데이 헤어케어의 창립자 제이미 럽턴이 뷰티 민주화를 목표로 연매출을 달성하며 추가 신규 브랜드들을 론칭할 계획이다.
